notes.title: 1.3.3.0 Beta Update
notes.notes:
1. Remake the skill of the King of Glory and change it to: all "units" enable all interfaces in four directions: up, down, left, right
2. Guangming and Law: The original effect is that all "separations" will not leave the core (except for the Flyer). Adjust it to not exclude any crew (after adjustment, the Golden Gyroscope and Flyer series will also not leave the core)
3. Number of ice lightning penetration+1
4. Fix possible errors in the quantity of one click equipment props and items
5. Fix the bug of ineffective initial selection of plasma shield and lord summoning in the revival ship
6. Fixed a bug where the beta version leaderboard may fail to upload
7. Fixed a bug where entering Abyss mode would overwrite the saved files of the basic game mode in certain situations
8. The content list blocked by the custom core has been enlarged on the store page

notes.title: 1.3.2.8 Beta Update

6. Fix bugs with abnormal effects in natural accounts and natural growth
7. Adjusted some effects of other cores and units
8. Fixed some other bugs

notes.title: 1.3.2.7 Beta Update
notes.notes:
1. Add a one click recycling/one click equipment mechanism. When obtaining item treasure chests, if the accumulated amount is greater than or equal to 4 ordinary treasure chests, 4 item treasure chests can be collected at once. For advanced treasure chests and those with less than 4 ordinary treasure chests, they still need to be collected sequentially!
2. Increased many achievements and chips
3. Fix some bugs
4. Slightly increased the price of chip recycling
5. Slightly increased the price of recycling high-grade units

notes.title: 1.3.2.2 Beta Update
notes.notes:
1. Added trial cores: Renaissance, Glacier
2. Added chip: Broken
3. Added a second confirmation to the "Retry" button in the pause interface to avoid misoperation; after 20 waves, the retry button will be replaced with End Exploration. (Last week, a feedback was received, saying that he accidentally clicked this button after playing to wave 66, and everything was in vain, and he has not yet entered the leaderboard. I am very sorry for this~)
4. After turning on the "Hide Hit Special Effects" switch, add hidden special effects: all melee damage hit special effects are hidden, missile pick-up gem special effects, missile disappearance special effects, poisoning instant kill special effects,
5. Fix bugs and improve performance: fix the problem that if the monster is continuously damaged by poison attributes after death, the "poison instant kill" and "spread" effects will still be triggered, resulting in a lot of invalid "instant kill" and "spread" texts on the screen.

notes.title: Beta version 1.2.9.9 update
notes.notes:
Recently updated some content, currently planned to test in the beta version for a week. If there are no major issues, it will be updated to the official version. The specific update content is as follows:


1. Moving the cursor to the level can display which attributes have been added for each upgrade selection (in the record system, only updated new games have this data, and if it is an ongoing battle save, it will immediately have this data displayed)
2. The laboratory has added a new feature called "Monster Catalog", which allows users to view information on defeated enemies and the number of times they have been defeated in the catalog.
3. Add category tabs to the system settings: Display, Sound, and Control (according to suggestions, more and more content can be set, but as the game version updates, the options page can no longer fit)
4. System settings added: Collecting aperture brightness, which can display the aperture within the collection range (default brightness 3%)
5. System settings added: hidden matrix halo effect, hidden knife light effect, hidden friendly missile effect
6. Fix the bug where the chip "Revelation" should increase quantum damage when refreshing the store, but actually increases luck

Balance adjustment:

Lightning Flyer, Hot Flyer: Slightly increase quantum damage bonus effect
Machine Gun Aviator, Ice Cone Aviator: Slightly Increases Long Range Damage Bonus Effect
Jet Flyer: Increases melee damage bonus effect slightly
Laser Flyer: Slightly Enhanced Technology Bonus Effect

Scholar: New Effect ->Attack Range Modification+50%
Bet number: New effect ->Invincibility after injury+0.2s
Smart Number: Gun Penetration Quantity Adjusted from+1 to+2
Ranger: Armor Modified from -100% to -50%
Load carrier: Attack speed adjusted from -50% to -25%
Thunder God: Damage Modified from -50% to -30%
Wings of Lightning: Attack Speed Modified from -50% to -30%
Pope Number: New Effect ->Business Modification+200%
Origin Number: Removal Effect ->Evasion -5%

notes.title: Update Version 1.1.1.2
notes.notes:
1. New feature "Rotate Core": The "Rotate Core" function has been added in the "Laboratory" - "Custom Core" section, which allows for the rotation of cores and more flexible use of cores with default interface numbers less than 4!
If "Custom Core" is used, a custom icon prompt will be added to the corresponding core in the core list to facilitate finding the modified core.
3. Fixed some bugs in the sealing system
4. Balance adjustment

notes.title: Update Version 1.0.0.8
notes.notes:
1. New function: Crew illustrations, you can enter the crew illustrations in the laboratory and view all crew information!
2. When the game is paused, add a prompt above the "Return to Main Menu" button: Save current progress
3. Add "Keyboard Layout" setting in the system settings, you can choose the keyboard layout, and add support for French QWERTY keyboards
4. Mist Voyager: Poisoning damage +50%
5. Add basic chips: virus spread, poison, sudden death (this type of chip only appears in the store when you have a poisoned crew, and is not limited to treasure chest drops)
6. Fixed the bug that the seal can be used infinitely when using the handle"

notes.title: Update Version 1.0.0.7
notes.notes:
1. Add a new hint icon on the store page, when you move the cursor to the hint icon, you can view the list of currently disabled and sealed products (the hint icon will be displayed only when there are products disabled and sealed).
2. Treasure Chest System Optimization: Disabled chips and sealed chips will not enter the treasure chest anymore.

3. Seal system: fix the bug of invalid sealing unit.
4. Seal system: fix the bug that when there are the same goods in the store, using seal will not seal the same goods in the same 5. step.
6. Seal system: after sealing all optional units, the units will no longer appear in the store.

7. French translation optimization:
